verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents per-version error visibility ('see which versions of your code are throwing exceptions'), deploy tracking, and tracking of which users each error affects. Together these give a rough per-release error view, but not true release-health metrics. Missing for 10: crash-free session and crash-free user rates, per-release adoption metrics, canary-vs-stable release comparison, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
